name: StoryGraph
description: Fetches metadata from StoryGraph, a book recommendation and tracking platform.

parameters.name: booklimit
parameters.description: Maximum books to return. Product of booklimit and editionlimit may not exceed 10. If not specified, defaults to 3.

parameters.name: editionlimit
parameters.description: Maximum editions per book to return. Product of booklimit and editionlimit may not exceed 10. If not specified, defaults to 1.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the audiobook searched for. If not specified, defaults to all (search in all languages).

parameters.name: pubyear
parameters.description: Which publication year to use for the publishedYear field in the returned metadata. If not specified, defaults to edition (the year the edition was first published).

comments: Uses the public search page of StoryGraph to fetch metadata, since there does not appear to be a public API available for this purpose.
